scripts.db:migrate: dotnet ef database update --project backend/src/Bla.Infrastructure --startup-project backend/src/Bla.Api
scripts.api:dev: dotenv -e backend/.env -v ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development -- dotnet run --project backend/src/Bla.Api
scripts.dev: npm run services:up && npm run db:migrate && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run api:dev" "npm run web:dev"
